<u>EAST PAKISTAN UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING & TECHNOLOGY, DACCA.</u>

Proceedings of the Meeting of the Academic Council held on 14.1.69.
<u>MEMBERS PRESENT:</u>
1. Dr. M.A.Rashid, Vice-Chancellor in the Chair.
2. Mr. S.A. Zahiruddin, Dean of the Faculty of Architecture & Planning & Head of the Department of Architecture - EPUET.,Dacca
3. Dr. M.A.Naser, Dean of the Faculty of Engineering & Head of the Department of Chemical Engineering - -do-
4. Mr. A. Q.Chowdhury, Professor & Head of Chemistry Department - -do-
5. Dr. Abul Hasnat, Professor & Head of Civil Engineering Department -do-
6. Dr. M.N.Azam, Professor & Head of Electrical Engineering Deptt. -do-
7. Mr.Momtazuddin, Head of the Department of Humanities - -do-
8. Mr.K.M.Zahiruddin, Professor & Head of Mathematics Department - -do-
9. Dr.V.G.DeSa, Professor & Head of Mechanical Engineering Deptt. - -do-
10. Mr.K.M.Saha, Professor & Head of Physics Department - -do-
11. Dr.M.S.H.K.Eusufzai, Professor of Civil Engineering - -do-
12. Dr. A.M.Zahoorul Huq, Professor of Electrical Engineering - -do-
13. Dr.M.H.Khan, Professor of Mechanical Engineering - -do-
14. Dr.Md.Serajul-Doulah, Associate Professor of Chemical Engineering -do-
15. Dr.Abdul Matin Patwary, Associate Professor of Electrical Engg. -do-
16. Mr. E.H.Bucknall, Associate Professor of Met.Engg. Deptt. - -do-
17. Mr. M. A. Jabbar, Director of Students' Welfare - -do-
18. Dr.Shamsul Alam, Director of Advisory,Extension & Research Services - -do-

<u>RESOLUTIONS:</u>
1. Confirmed the Proceedings of the last meeting of the Academic Council held on 18.9.68.
2. Considered the recommendations of the Faculty of Engineering made in their meeting held on 30.12.68 and approved after amendments as per Appendix - 1 and further resolved that the resolution 7 for adopting 5 day-week with 7 periods per day, be referred to Inter-University Board of Pakistan by the teacher-representative of this University for their consideration.
3. Considered and approved the recommendations of the Faculty of Architecture & Planning made in their meeting held on 19.11.68 as per Appendix - II.
4. Consideration of the Ministry of Education letter No. F.15-179/66-Tech.I dated 18.9.68 regarding recognition of Degrees awarded by the Middle East Technical University was postponed and to be considered in the next meeting with the recommendation of the Equivalence Committee.
5. Considered and approved the recommendation of the Equivalence Committee for the Faculty of Architecture and Planning for admission of one Rafi Omar into First year class of the Faculty of Architecture and Planning as per Appendix - III.

-2-

=== PAGE 2 ===
-2-

6. Considered and approved the results of the Winter Semester Examination 1967-68 as per Appendix - IV except the case of Roll No.8 of 5th Semester Electrical Engineering who is declared referred in EE.503 and he is to appear at a special Referred examination in that subject to be arranged by Head of the Department of Electrical Engineering.
7. Considered the proposal of the Head of the Department of Architecture to form an Admission Committee for the Department of Physical Planning and resolved that an Admission Committee for the Department of Physical Planning be formed as follows:-
1. Mr. S.A.Zahiruddin, Head of Architecture Department - Chairman
2. Mr. Q.M.A.Akef, Asstt.Professor of Physical Planning - Member
3. Mr. G.Rahman, Asstt.Professor of Physical Planning - "
4. Dr.Rahmatullah, Asstt.Professor Physical Planning - "
5. Mr. Aftab Mohd. Khan, Urban Development Director,Segunbagicha - "

8. Considered the Section 6(i) of the Ordinances regarding Re-Admission and resolved that same be amended to read as follows:-
6(i) "Every students whose name has been struck off by exercise of sub-section (ii) & (iii) and (iv) of Section 5 seeking re-admission shall submit an application in the prescribed form within 15 days of the commencement of the session to which he seeks re-admission along with the original mark-sheet of the previous examination and no dues certificate from the Accounts Section, Library and Provost of the Hall concerned to the Director of Students' Welfare who shall forward the application along with a report on the conduct and character of student to the Chairman of the Re-Admission Committee which shall be constituted by the Academic Council for each session, for necessary action.
In case the applicant is allowed by the Re-Admission Committee to take re-admission, he will be required to pay within one week of the receipt of the permission from the Re-Admission Committee, the Re-Admission fees and all other fees and he shall be re-admitted on payment of all the dues. An information to this effect shall be sent by the Registrar to the Head of the Department concerned and the Director of the Students' Welfare".

9. Considered the Ministry of Education letter No.F.9-43/68-UE-II dated 20.9.68 for the views of the University regarding declaration on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women and resolved that the declaration as mentioned above be approved. Further resolved to recommend that Women students desiring accommodation may be accommodated in a residential flat of one of the University residential buildings and placed under the charge of a senior teacher accommodated in the adjacent flat.

-3-

=== PAGE 3 ===
-3-

10. Considered the note of the Assistant Registrar, Examination Section regarding determination of the position of students who secured 40% to 50% marks in sessional subjects under Semester system and now following Annual system and later on were exempted in those subjects by the Head of the Department and resolved that they are to be declared to have passed in those subjects and the same percentage of marks which they secured under Semester system be retained.
11. Considered the proposal of the Head of the Department of Civil Engineering to create the post of the Chief Instructor for the Department of Civil Engineering and resolved that same can not be recommended.
12. Consideration of the proposal for fixing up the rates of remuneration for setting papers, examination scripts, etc., in different examinations under Annual system was postponed and referred to the Dean of the Faculty of Engineering for making a comprehensive proposal for this on the basis that entire proceeds from examination fees be fully spent in the various items of expenditure connected with the examination so that neither loss nor gain accrues to the University from examination fees.
13. Considered the proposal for fixing up the rates of admission fees, tuition fees, examination fees, etc., for the students of Master of Physical Planning Course and resolved that the rates be same as those of M.Sc.Courses under the Faculty of Engineering.
14. Considered the cases of students who failed in the 4th Semester examination and resolved that their rules for re-admission will be similar to those who failed in the 2nd Semester last year as per Appendix - V, further resolved that this rule will be followed in future as a general principle.
15. Considered the decision of the Syndicate taken in their meeting held on 21st and 23rd November,1968 for creation of 2 posts of Visiting Associate Professors, one in the Department of Metallurgical Engineering and the other in the Department of Physical Planning and resolved that the same be concurred.
16. Considered the Ministry of Industries and Natural Resources letter No.20(12)/64-GII dated 30.11.68 for arrangements to be made for conduction of Part - I of the Degree Course of Pakistan College of Mineral Technology, Quetta, with East Pakistan University of Engineering & Technology, Dacca, as per Appendix - VI and resolved that on principle this be approved. Further resolved that the Ministry of Industries and Natural Resources be moved to set up a Committee consisting of the nominees of the Academic Council of this University and West Pakistan and representatives of the Pakistan College of Mineral Technology,Quetta for drawing up a syllabus of the proposed Part-I Course so that least difficulties are involved in offering the course by the Universities with their existing facilities.

-4-

=== PAGE 4 ===
-4-

17. Considered the procedure for seeking admission on transfer from other Universities and resolved that the candidate concerned should apply to the Head of the Department in which he seeks admission and the Head of the Department should give his recommendation to the Equivalence Committee, which in case both agree for giving admission, the student may be admitted without referring to the Academic Council; but if the Head of the department and the Equivalence Committee are of different opinion, the matter should be referred to the Academic Council for final decision.
18. Considered the proposal of the Registrar for forming an Admission Committee for the Faculty of Engineering for 1969 and resolved that an Admission Committee be formed with all the Heads of the Departments under the Faculty of Engineering as members with Dean of the Faculty of Engineering as its Chairman.
19. Considered the proposal of Dean of the Faculty of Engineering for amendment of sub-section (iv) of section 1 and section 9 of the University Ordinances regarding M.Sc.(Engg.) Courses and resolved that the same be amended to read as follows:-
1(iv) Before being finally selected for admission the candidates may be required to appear at an interview by the appropriate Selection Committee. They may be required to take pre-requisite and/or make-up courses as may be prescribed by the Head of the Department concerned.

9 Under all circumstances a student shall be required to complete the course and qualify for the award of the degree of M.Sc.Engg. in the relevant branch in (i) three years for full time student (ii) five years for part-time students from the date of his first enrolment in the course.

20. Considered the recommendations of the Board of Studies, Department of Physical Planning made in their meeting held on 2-1 -1969 and resolved that the same be approved as per Appendix - VII.

Approved
Sd/- M.A.Rashid
Vice-Chancellor

( K.M.Zahiruddin ) 20/2/69
Registrar

SMH/- 20.2.69.
